rationale: The mapping is not internally faithful to all raw values: “Cmax or AUC0-12 brain/plasma ratio” is assigned to an AUC-and-Cmax label even though it is explicitly alternative, and KO/WT brain-to-plasma AUC ratio-of-ratios remain on the generic AUC ratio. The protected component and comparison semantics are therefore not fully preserved.

The split overstates binding/total status for “total brain exposure as percentage of plasma exposure” by assigning a total-plasma denominator that is not stated, while “brain-to-plasma KO/WT exposure enhancement ratio” remains on the generic exposure ratio. The total and genotype-comparison dimensions are not consistently preserved.

Several raw values still collapse protected dimensions: “Cbr/Cpf x 100” has a free-plasma denominator, “Cb/Cp and CCSF/Cp” is a brain-plus-CSF composite, and KO/WT ratio-of-ratios remain generic. Total-state mappings are also inconsistent for near-identical “Brain/plasma (total)” wording. This decision needs further splitting.
